title: I Built A Tool That Tracks Insider Trading
author: Potential_Caramel917
selftext:
5 years ago when i came across Deep Fucking Value and Insider Trading and ive been using it as part of my analysis every since.  
  
(and its been working pretty well im up 45% in the past year on my TFSA)  
  
But openinsider always just felt laggy, missed a lot of filters and you always had to keep checking it since there wasnt an alert option.  
  
So earlier this year i decided to build [kestrelterminal](http://kestrelterminal.com/) as a side project for personal use to do exactly what openinsider couldnt.  
  
If any of yall are interested, just lmk and ill give you free access.  
  
It would mean a lot if you checked it out, and let me know if theres any changes I can make or improvements youd might like.  
  
[Kestrelterminal.com](http://kestrelterminal.com/)

replies.author: Potential_Caramel917
replies.body:
basically its legally required to filed all insider trades to the SEC. and we basically scrape every single transaction and have it listed on our software. Our custom alerts/algo then scans throuhg all those transactions (becuase 99% of it is just noise). and runs it through certain variables that we've back tested to have the highest returns, before then sending the alerts to you

let me know if you have any other questions!

replies.author: fujimonster
replies.body: You could have claude make you a python script or a front end in a few minutes. Have it periodically go look for SEC Form 4 filings.  You'll also want to go get the form for the company that lists directories and other officials salaries but I cannot give you the form off the top of my head.   Have it look at the form to see if it is their own money they are using to purchase and if it's a considerable more amount than they are reported to make.  If they are dumping a lot of their own cash into it, then here is a good sign they know something and it might pop.
